title: Strapped Planks (The Jobless Barrels)
description: Since nobody done it in every modding community, fine I'll do it myself
body:
Are you professional builder that uses barrels to make awesome build? do you deny this darn villagers that keep turning into fishermen? Worry no more since nobody made this.

Introducing the Strapped Planks also known as Jobless Planks. This custom plank only adds a single block, that dont have a function than just a homeless type of barrel.

![Heres how to craft it (works with every planks)](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f47a9df204a3c77db982ad762b2074715a080b84.png)

For the preview of the blocks, check the Gallery

Note: The way you place this block is the same way you place the log blocks.
